description: Run the buyout model 1.0 of Annalist Deal Lab on a company's published figures, at its starting values or with the caller's assumptions under the keys of the address of the page (entry, exit_mult, years, debt, growth, margin, tax, base and the others that the starting values list). Returns the returns, sources and uses, the debt schedule, the covenants and the checks of the model, optionally the 3 solvers, every input with its source document ids, and the address of the same deal on the site. Shares and rates are fractions (0.2 for 20%) and multiples are times EBITDA. The result is arithmetic on published figures and the caller's assumptions: it values no company, recommends no transaction and forecasts nothing.

assumptions.description: assumptions to change, for example {"entry": 8, "debt": 4}; leave out for the starting values

company.description: company id from search_companies, for example apple

solvers.description: also return the highest entry multiple for the target return, the growth it needs and the debt capacity

name: run_buyout
title: Run a buyout model
